title: Laravel Declaration manifest
description: The YAML file at `laravel-declaration.manifest` (default `manifest/app.yml`): a body on Illuminate\Foundation\Application.

requests.description: Data: the FormRequest declarations a route's `metadata: {request: name}` names (DeclaredRequest).

models.description: Data: the Eloquent model declarations a DeclaredModel subclass reads by its class name.

queries.description: Data: the named Eloquent queries DeclaredView data and DeclaredQuery::run() resolve.

schema.description: Data: the database schema body `declaration:migrate` applies.

extra.description: Data: free-form keys for the application's own providers, read through ManifestStore::block('extra').

Illuminate\\Foundation\\Application.description: Illuminate\Foundation\Application methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

useLangPath.description: -> useLangPath($path): a relative path resolves under basePath(). Keys apply in manifest order — declare it before `setLocale`.

registered.description: -> registered($callback): a map is a body on the application once every provider has registered — the place for bindings that must win over the app's own providers; a list item is a `closure` reference.

register.description: -> register($provider, $force), one call per item or entry: the manifest's own service providers, registered at register() in manifest order and booted with every other provider.

make.description: -> make($abstract), one call per entry: the entry's map is a body on the resolved service — the form for a service that is already resolved at register() (`Illuminate\Config\Repository`).

booting.description: -> booting($callback): a map is a body on the application first in boot(); a list item is a `closure` reference receiving $app.

booted.description: -> booted($callback): a map is a body on the application last in boot() — every service is resolvable, so `make:` here addresses services other providers resolved earlier; a list item is a `closure` reference receiving $app.

terminating.description: -> terminating($callback), one call per item: a `closure` reference called after the response, injected by the container.

when.description: -> when($concrete), one call per entry: the entry's map is a body on the ContextualBindingBuilder it returns (`needs`, `give`, `giveTagged`, `giveConfig`).

bind.description: -> bind($abstract, $concrete, $shared), one call per entry: the key is the abstract, the value a class-string, `~` (self-binding) or a `.php` file returning the resolver Closure ($app, $parameters). A list item binds its own name.

bindIf.description: -> bindIf($abstract, $concrete, $shared), one call per entry: skipped when the abstract is already bound (deferred services included). A list item binds its own name.

singleton.description: -> singleton($abstract, $concrete), one call per entry: shared for the process. A list item binds its own name.

singletonIf.description: -> singletonIf($abstract, $concrete), one call per entry: skipped when the abstract is already bound.

scoped.description: -> scoped($abstract, $concrete), one call per entry: shared until forgetScopedInstances().

scopedIf.description: -> scopedIf($abstract, $concrete), one call per entry: skipped when the abstract is already bound.

extend.description: -> extend($abstract, $closure), one call per entry: a `.php` file's Closure receives ($instance, $app); a map is a body on the extended service.

instance.description: -> instance($abstract, $instance), one call per entry: a `.php` file binds its return value (any type); anything else binds as YAML decoded it — a class-string is bound verbatim (`singleton` is the native way to share a class).

resolving.description: -> resolving($abstract, $callback), one call per entry: a map is a body on the resolving service (matched by type); a reference or a list of references registers each Closure ($object, $app).

afterResolving.description: -> afterResolving($abstract, $callback), one call per entry: a map is a body on the resolved service — matched by type, so a concrete FQCN (`Illuminate\Foundation\Http\Kernel`) fires for a contract-bound service; a reference or a list of references registers each Closure ($object, $app). Does not fire for a service already resolved at register(): use `make:`.

Illuminate\\Routing\\Router.description: Illuminate\Routing\Router methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

redirect.description: -> redirect($uri, $destination, $status), one call per row; every other key rides the returned Route.

permanentRedirect.description: -> permanentRedirect($uri, $destination), one call per row; every other key rides the returned Route.

view.description: -> view($uri, $view, $data, $status, $headers), one call per row (GET|HEAD); every other key rides the returned Route.

resource.description: -> resource($name, $controller, $options), one call per row; every other key rides the returned PendingResourceRegistration (`only`, `middleware`, `names`, `scoped: ~`, `missing`, …). An unknown key fails at boot with BadMethodCallException.

apiResource.description: -> apiResource($name, $controller, $options), one call per row; every other key rides the returned PendingResourceRegistration.

singleton.description: -> singleton($name, $controller, $options), one call per row; every other key rides the returned PendingSingletonResourceRegistration (`creatable: ~`, `destroyable: ~`, …).

apiSingleton.description: -> apiSingleton($name, $controller, $options), one call per row; every other key rides the returned PendingSingletonResourceRegistration.

group.description: -> group($attributes, $routes), one call per row: `attributes` is the native array (prefix, as, namespace, domain, controller, middleware, where, metadata); `routes` is a body on the router inside the group (`addRoute`, `resource`, `group`, …).

addRoute.description: -> addRoute($methods, $uri, $action), one call per row: `methods` is passed verbatim (write `GET`), `action` a controller class, `Class@method` or [Class, method]; every other key rides the returned Route (`name`, `where`, `middleware`, `missing`, `metadata`, `setDefaults`, …).

matched.description: -> matched($callback): One call per item; registers a RouteMatched listener (fires at dispatch, before route middleware). `Class` (method `handle`, bare invokables fall back to `__invoke`) or `Class@method`, called with ($event).

aliasMiddleware.description: -> aliasMiddleware($name, $class): Registers a route middleware alias on the router, usable in any route's `middleware` list (with an optional `:params` suffix).

middlewareGroup.description: -> middlewareGroup($name, $middleware), one call per entry: defines/replaces a route middleware group on the router. Items are middleware class-strings, aliases, or `alias:params` forms; resolved at dispatch. The HTTP kernel syncs its own groups to the router when it resolves.

prependMiddlewareToGroup.description: -> prependMiddlewareToGroup($group, $middleware): One call per item, reversed so declared order lands at the group head. Silent no-op when the group is missing.

pushMiddlewareToGroup.description: -> pushMiddlewareToGroup($group, $middleware): One call per item; appends to the group, creating it when missing. No-op when already present.

removeMiddlewareFromGroup.description: -> removeMiddlewareFromGroup($group, $middleware): One call per item; removes the middleware from the group. Silent no-op when the group or the middleware is missing. The only remove seam in Laravel (the kernel has none).

bind.description: -> bind($key, $binder), one call per entry: `Class` (method `bind`) or `Class@method`, make()d and called ($value, $route) in SubstituteBindings. Not an invokable, not `Class::method`.

model.description: -> model($key, $class), one call per entry: {key} resolves through $class::resolveRouteBinding($value) in SubstituteBindings (`web`/`api` groups), on every route. 404 when null; a route's `missing` handles it. Ignores {key:field} and scopeBindings.

pattern.description: -> pattern($key, $pattern), one call per entry: a global `where`, merged into every route created afterwards (URI and domain parameters). A route's own `where` wins. Single-quote the regex: `[` starts a YAML list.

singularResourceParameters.description: -> singularResourceParameters($singular): false pluralizes resource parameter names globally ({posts}). Absent: Laravel's default (true). Baked into route:cache.

resourceParameters.description: -> resourceParameters($parameters): One call with the whole map; replaces the global resource parameter map ({resource: paramName}). Baked into route:cache.

resourceVerbs.description: -> resourceVerbs($verbs): One call with the whole map; array_merges the resource verbs (create/edit) used in resource URIs. Baked into route:cache.

Illuminate\\Routing\\Route.description: Illuminate\Routing\Route methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

missing.description: -> missing($missing): a `closure` reference (an invokable class, `Class@method`) called ($request, $exception) when a model binding fails.

metadata.description: -> metadata($metadata): merged into the route's metadata; `request` names the `requests` item a DeclaredRequest validates.

Illuminate\\Routing\\PendingResourceRegi.description: Illuminate\Routing\PendingResourceRegistration methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

missing.description: -> missing($callback): a `closure` reference called ($request, $exception) when a model binding fails.

Illuminate\\Routing\\PendingSingletonRes.description: Illuminate\Routing\PendingSingletonResourceRegistration methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

Illuminate\\Container\\ContextualBinding.description: Illuminate\Container\ContextualBindingBuilder methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

give.description: -> give($implementation): a class-string, a `.php` file returning a Closure (also for primitives — `needs: '$count'`), or a list of class-strings for a typed variadic.

Illuminate\\Config\\Repository.description: Illuminate\Config\Repository methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

set.description: -> set($key, $value), one call per entry: the key is a dotted config path, the value replaces that node whole (Repository::set semantics); the row form {key, value} sets a list value.

Illuminate\\Foundation\\Http\\Kernel.description: Illuminate\Foundation\Http\Kernel methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

whenRequestLifecycleIsLongerThan.description: -> whenRequestLifecycleIsLongerThan($threshold, $handler), one call per entry: the key is the threshold in milliseconds, the value a `closure` reference called ($startedAt, $request, $response).

prependMiddleware.description: -> prependMiddleware($middleware): Prepends to the global middleware stack.

pushMiddleware.description: -> pushMiddleware($middleware): Appends to the global middleware stack.

prependMiddlewareToGroup.description: -> prependMiddlewareToGroup($group, $middleware): Prepends to a route middleware group.

appendMiddlewareToGroup.description: -> appendMiddlewareToGroup($group, $middleware): Appends to a route middleware group.

prependToMiddlewarePriority.description: -> prependToMiddlewarePriority($middleware): Prepends to middleware priority list.

appendToMiddlewarePriority.description: -> appendToMiddlewarePriority($middleware): Appends to middleware priority list.

addToMiddlewarePriorityBefore.description: -> addToMiddlewarePriorityBefore($before, $middleware): Inserts middleware before target anchor.

addToMiddlewarePriorityAfter.description: -> addToMiddlewarePriorityAfter($after, $middleware): Inserts middleware after target anchor.

setGlobalMiddleware.description: -> setGlobalMiddleware($middleware): Replaces the global middleware stack.

setMiddlewareGroups.description: -> setMiddlewareGroups($groups): Replaces all route middleware groups.

setMiddlewareAliases.description: -> setMiddlewareAliases($aliases): Defines or overrides middleware aliases.

setMiddlewarePriority.description: -> setMiddlewarePriority($priority): Replaces the priority order of route middleware.

Illuminate\\View\\Factory.description: Illuminate\View\Factory methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

share.description: -> share($key, $value), one call per entry: every entry reaches every view as YAML decoded it. View data, creators and composers override it. Never share `__env` or `app`.

addLocation.description: -> addLocation($location), one call per item: searched after config('view.paths'). A relative path resolves under basePath().

prependLocation.description: -> prependLocation($location), one call per item: searched before every other location. A relative path resolves under basePath().

addNamespace.description: -> addNamespace($namespace, $hints), one call per entry: `namespace::view` searches these paths after the hints already registered.

prependNamespace.description: -> prependNamespace($namespace, $hints), one call per entry: searched before the hints already registered, so it overrides a package's views.

replaceNamespace.description: -> replaceNamespace($namespace, $hints), one call per entry: discards the hints already registered. Laravel replaces `errors` and `mail` itself at render.

addExtension.description: -> addExtension($extension, $engine), one call per entry: `.$extension` files render with $engine (blade, php, file) and are found before every other extension.

flushState.description: -> flushState(): `~` resets renderCount, renderedOnce, sections, stacks, components and fragments (worker and test isolation).

flushFinderCache.description: -> flushFinderCache(): `~` empties the finder's resolved-view cache, so locations declared in the same body win over finds cached earlier (a `booted:` body with `make:` when another provider resolved the factory first).

creator.description: -> creator($views, $callback), one call per entry: the key is one view name, the value the creator class (method `create`) or `Class@method`; the row form {views: [a, b], callback} attaches one creator to several views.

composer.description: -> composer($views, $callback), one call per entry: the key is one view name (`*` wildcards allowed), the value the composer class (method `compose`) or `Class@method`; the row form {views: [a, b], callback} attaches one composer to several views.

Illuminate\\View\\Compilers\\BladeCompil.description: Illuminate\View\Compilers\BladeCompiler methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

Illuminate\\Validation\\Factory.description: Illuminate\Validation\Factory methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

extend.description: -> extend($rule, $extension, $message), one call per entry: the key is the rule name, the value the extension reference (`Class@method`, or a class with a `validate` method); the row form {rule, extension, message} declares the factory-wide fallback message.

extendImplicit.description: -> extendImplicit($rule, $extension, $message): the rule runs even when the field is absent or empty.

extendDependent.description: -> extendDependent($rule, $extension, $message): the parsed rule lands in dependentRules, so its parameters may reference other fields.

replacer.description: -> replacer($rule, $replacer), one call per entry: the value replaces message placeholders; a bare class-string resolves to its `replace` method.

Illuminate\\Auth\\Access\\Gate.description: Illuminate\Auth\Access\Gate methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

define.description: -> define($ability, $callback), one call per entry: the key is the ability name, the value the 'Class@method' or invokable class-string reference, passed through untouched.

policy.description: -> policy($class, $policy), one call per entry: the key is the model class-string, the value the policy class-string.

Illuminate\\Routing\\ResponseFactory.description: Illuminate\Routing\ResponseFactory methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

Illuminate\\Pagination\\Paginator.description: Illuminate\Pagination\Paginator methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

useBootstrapFive.description: -> useBootstrapFive(): `~` on the static receiver (root key `Illuminate\Pagination\Paginator`); the last preset declared wins, `defaultView`/`defaultSimpleView` override it when declared after.

Illuminate\\Database\\Connection.description: Illuminate\Database\Connection methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

Illuminate\\Database\\Schema\\Builder.description: Illuminate\Database\Schema\Builder methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

table.description: -> table($table, $callback), one call per entry: the entry's map is a body on the Blueprint; `declaration:migrate` guards every action against the live schema (a column is added when missing, changed when present, …).

create.description: -> create($table, $callback), one call per entry: the entry's map is a body on the Blueprint (`id: ~`, `string: [name, {column: email, unique: ~}]`, `timestamps: ~`); `declaration:migrate` skips a table that exists.

drop.description: -> drop($table), one call per item (fails loudly if the table is missing).

rename.description: -> rename($from, $to), one call per entry ({old: new}) or per row ({from, to}); `declaration:migrate` skips it unless `from` exists and `to` does not.

Illuminate\\Database\\Schema\\Blueprint.description: Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

Illuminate\\Database\\Schema\\ForeignIdC.description: Illuminate\Database\Schema\ForeignIdColumnDefinition methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

Illuminate\\Database\\Schema\\ForeignKey.description: Illuminate\Database\Schema\ForeignKeyDefinition methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s); keys apply in manifest order.

classString.description: A fully-qualified class name. Write it plain or single-quoted; double quotes make `\` an escape.

reference.description: A PHP reference: an invokable FQCN, `Class@method`, `Class::method` (static) or a namespaced function. There is no array form.

phpFile.description: A `.php` file, required once per process; its return value is used. Relative paths resolve under basePath(); one starting with `/` or `\` is used as-is.

closure.description: A PHP reference — an invokable FQCN, `Class@method`, `Class::method` or a namespaced function — wrapped in a Closure that pairs the call's positional arguments with the target's parameter names and lets the container inject the rest; or a `.php` file returning a Closure.

concrete.description: A class-string or another bound abstract (not `Class@method`), `~` for a self-binding, or a `.php` file returning a Closure called as ($app, $parameters).

path.description: A filesystem path. Relative paths resolve under basePath(); one starting with `/` or `\` is used as-is.

authorize.description: FormRequest::authorize(): bool|Response. A boolean passes through; a string is a PHP reference resolved via Container::call; a map declares one native Gate call — the key is the Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Access\Gate method name (check, any, none, allows, denies, inspect, authorize, raw) and the value is a map of that method's native parameter names (ability|abilities, arguments). `arguments` follows Authorize::getGateArguments(): a class-string passes through, a route parameter name resolves to its bound value, a quoted literal unquotes.

model.description: Every key except the reserved `class` is an Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model property, assigned before Laravel initializes the model as if written in the class body, or a Model method. An unknown key fails this schema (authoring-time guard) and is ignored at runtime.

class.description: Reserved: the DeclaredModel subclass, spelled as static::class spells it (no leading `\`).

connection.description: -> $connection (#[Connection]): a database.connections name. Absent: the default connection.

table.description: -> $table (#[Table(name)]). Absent: the snake-case plural of the class basename.

timestamps.description: -> $timestamps (#[WithoutTimestamps]). Absent: true. false also makes other models skip touching this one.

dateFormat.description: -> $dateFormat (#[DateFormat]): how date columns are stored. Absent: the connection grammar's format.

attributes.description: -> $attributes: raw, storable default values of a new model.

casts.description: -> $casts: attribute => cast string (boolean, array, datetime:Y-m-d, encrypted:array, an enum, a cast class, Class:arg). A casts() method in the class is merged over it.

hidden.description: -> $hidden (#[Hidden]): left out of toArray() and toJson().

visible.description: -> $visible (#[Visible]): when non-empty, the only attributes in toArray() and toJson().

appends.description: -> $appends (#[Appends]): accessors added to toArray() and toJson(). The accessor is a method in the class.

with.description: -> $with: relations eager loaded by every query. The relation is a method in the class.

withCount.description: -> $withCount: relation counts ({relation}_count) loaded by every query.

touches.description: -> $touches (#[Touches]): relations whose updated_at is touched when this model saves.

refreshes.description: -> $refreshes (#[Refreshes]): columns re-read from the database after each save.

dispatchesEvents.description: -> $dispatchesEvents: model event => event class, dispatched as new $class($model).

observables.description: -> $observables: custom event names an observer method may handle.

observe.description: -> observe($classes) when the model boots, where Laravel applies #[ObservedBy]: one listener per observer method named after an observable event.

addGlobalScope.description: -> addGlobalScope($scope), one call per item when the model boots, where Laravel applies #[ScopedBy]: an Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope class.

getRouteKeyName.description: -> getRouteKeyName() (#[RouteKey]): the column router.model and route() use. Absent: the primary key.

schema.description: A body on Illuminate\Database\Schema\Builder, driven by `declaration:migrate` in the order dropIfExists → drop → rename → create → table with the guard table (§2.4).

bodies.description: A map keyed by projected class names: each value is a body on that class (`make`, `afterResolving`, …).
